# [Gen Z torches their American dream by abandoning marriage forever](https://substack.com/redirect/f34af047-4ddd-401a-817f-9f42b963334a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Only 37% of Gen Z see marriage as American Dream key, down hard from past generations, singles under 35 stuck at $22k/$9k median net worth vs married $114k, happiness over dynasties. These kids prioritizing solo vibes while data screams wealth gap. Pure long-term suicide for compounding.
• **Winners?** Rental REITs, divorce lawyers and solo consumer plays cashing loneliness premium.
• **Losers?** Future GDP, birth rates and these kids' retirement funds, they'll beg for the Dream they scorned.
• **Next?** Regret wave hits 30s, policy bribes or demographic panic forces reset.
This is weakness destroying the ultimate joint venture. Real capitalists build empires and families. These snowflakes reject proven math and get crushed by reality. Load plays that profit from fragmented society not the family unit they just torched. Harsh truth pays.

# [BofA CEO crushes recession fears calling economy rock solid](https://substack.com/redirect/544d3cad-93eb-46f0-8839-aed79c33ad28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Moynihan on air: no recession, rates high signal strength, BofA forecasts three hikes to '28 on sticky inflation/oil shock but growth beats estimates. Warsh focused on stability.
• **Winners?** Banks, cyclicals and anyone long the "strong economy" trade.
• **Losers?** Recession perma-bears and weak hands panicking on Fed noise.
• **Next?** Data confirms Goldilocks, selective buying, rates stay elevated rewarding cash kings.
This dismisses the doom chorus I laughed at in multiple pieces. The economy is resilient, inflation managed, Musk/SpaceX valuations safe. Smart CEO talk beats Wall Street hawks. Buy quality, ignore the fear porn. America prints while weak nations fold. Position aggressive.

# [Oil slams back to pre-war lows as US-Iran talks ignite breakthrough](https://substack.com/redirect/544d3cad-93eb-46f0-8839-aed79c33ad28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Brent under $71 (-0.8%), WTI under $68 (-1.1%), Qatar confirms progress post-Khamenei funeral, Strait risk premium vaporized. My Iran deal prediction crushed again.
• **Winners?** Consumers, refiners and growth stocks getting cheap energy fuel, US leverage kings.
• **Losers?** Upstream producers banking on sustained spikes, Iran bleeding cash harder.
• **Next?** More talks or Trump pressure, volatility stays but floor holds, SpaceX valuations breathe easier.
Precisely as I called in **["The Iran deal and the Space X IPO,"](https://substack.com/redirect/d217ba0f-6e1a-4190-9412-0948fc56f6a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Headlines slam oil, US wins assets or stability. Risk premium gone, economy stronger, Musk empire cheaper to run. Buy the dip on energy-sensitive winners, hedge the noise. This is how deals print.

# [Marvell set to explode if Amazon opens Trainium chips outside AWS](https://substack.com/redirect/544d3cad-93eb-46f0-8839-aed79c33ad28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Amazon flipping Trainium sales external, Marvell as design partner positioned for third-party data center boom. Custom silicon tailwind expands addressable market hard.
• **Winners?** MRVL shareholders and hyperscaler partners cashing custom AI demand.
• **Losers?** Pure GPU plays facing more competition, concentration-risk bears proven wrong.
• **Next?** Bookings accelerate, multi-year programs lock, stock rerates on broader wins.
Ties straight to my **["Wall Street crowns Micron the next"](https://substack.com/redirect/0c4b240d-9b4a-4b58-a6e5-8423a22e9dc6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** semis feast on AI infra. Marvell rides the custom wave while others chase. This is how you win the silicon war, partner smart, scale quiet. Buy MRVL on any dip. Tech eats the world.

# [Jersey Mike's files for IPO after riding the SpaceX public wave like a pro](https://substack.com/redirect/544d3cad-93eb-46f0-8839-aed79c33ad28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Jersey Mike's just S-1'd with $724M revenue, $55M net income jump from $5M, $4.3B system sales +13%, 50% cumulative same-store growth since 2020, nearly 3,300 stores and Blackstone's $8B stake flipping public under JMKE. Franchise royalty machine crushing a weak industry. The tsunami is here, real operators cashing in.
• **Winners?** Blackstone harvesting billions, founder Cancro keeping equity, franchisees and hungry investors chasing the next Wingstop pop.
• **Losers?** Laggard subs like Subway getting hoagied, any chain too slow for the value game.
• **Next?** Hot debut, $10B+ valuation, European push, more QSR filings flood the window.
This is capitalism printing strong brands eat weak while crybabies moan about "sluggish dine-out." Consumers still pay for good subs. Position now or watch the subs eat your lunch. Smart money loads the boat.

subject: Trump believes he gets to use the power of government to silence, extort, bankrupt, or even prosecute anyone who criticizes him.

Donald Trump’s view of the First Amendment is that he gets to say whatever he wants, AND he gets to use the power of government to silence, extort, bankrupt, or even prosecute anyone who criticizes him. Case and point: After Senator Jack Reed went on Fox News to tell the truth about Trump’s failed war in Iran, Trump took to Truth Social calling on Sen. Reed to be impeached. Look, we need to hold Donald Trump — and every Republican in Congress who supported his war — accountable. And we need leaders in office who are not afraid to speak truth to power — even if they’re intimidated into silence. [**So I’m asking you to please split a donation of $28 or anything you can to support Jack Reed’s re-election campaign today. We’re going to keep speaking truth to power and fighting back against Trump’s intimidation campaign.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3700?amount=28&t=8&akid=2955%2E4032634%2EbpTw36)

name: Jenny Beth Martin, Tea Party Patriots Action
subject: The Revolution's bravest women
body:
A new audio drama for America's 250th. Episode one is live today, and your free Activity Book is waiting.
[](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Ffoundation/1/0100019f2562e19e-144adade-b5f0-448b-b4a0-822bad529aad-000000/lIU3yowRPZC1qoigtbhTZDybzW04nx_HZj66Rng6BRk=452)[](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Ffoundation%2Fdefiant-ones%2F/1/0100019f2562e19e-144adade-b5f0-448b-b4a0-822bad529aad-000000/rsGsh8Nom22n1wTze5I8RUxw1DMbOonMLty0MmGvtLw=452)Patriot–Two hundred and fifty years ago this week, a group of Americans did something the world said was impossible. They declared themselves free.We know the men who signed their names. We say many of those names every Fourth of July. But standing behind them, and often out in front of them, were women whose courage has been all but erased from the story.Today, that changes.I am proud to tell you that [__Defiant Ones: The American Revolution's Bravest Women__](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Ffoundation%2Fdefiant-ones%2F/2/0100019f2562e19e-144adade-b5f0-448b-b4a0-822bad529aad-000000/Y382g7H653pBrlI2zCb3TjdXg5F8xfju8qKV-WSBkKc=452) launches today. It is an eight-episode audio drama, produced with real cinematic craft, and it brings to life the women who carried messages through enemy lines, ran the farms and the print shops, nursed the wounded, and in more than one case picked up a musket themselves.This is not a dry history lecture. It is the real story, performed by a remarkable cast, and it is exactly what I hoped we could help produce as our country marks its 250th birthday.Episode one is available right now. A new episode drops every Thursday through August 20.[_**Start listening now.**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Ffoundation%2Fdefiant-ones%2F/3/0100019f2562e19e-144adade-b5f0-448b-b4a0-822bad529aad-000000/iamkoQ6JgZx6r9C1jnSso5jsw4zourS0jSCo1z1EMso=452) Tea Party Patriots Foundation is honored to be part of bringing this series to you, alongside the team that created it. I recently sat down with one of its creators, Shari Rigby, on _The Jenny Beth Show_ , and I came away certain this is worth your time, and your family's time.Two hundred and fifty years ago, these women refused to sit on the sidelines of history. The least we can do is remember them.[_**Go listen.**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Ffoundation%2Fdefiant-ones%2F/4/0100019f2562e19e-144adade-b5f0-448b-b4a0-822bad529aad-000000/ct1TmQBuZA-VYAHF6ZJb5D8tnuH7o4fR_3qoiiNsgjM=452) Then forward this to someone who loves this country and the truth about how it was won.In liberty,Jenny Beth Martin
President, Tea Party Patriots Foundation
P.S. This series was built for families. If you homeschool, if you lead a study group at your church, or if you simply want your kids and grandkids to know the truth about who fought for their freedom, [_**there is a free activity book that was made for you**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Ftpp-resources.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fdocuments%2FDefianOnes-ActivityBook.pdf/1/0100019f2562e19e-144adade-b5f0-448b-b4a0-822bad529aad-000000/jVLyk8FoVQzv5B65iZb37Xi2vWTaRs4W_Yg_7EKVztw=452). Use it while listening to the series, and share this series widely.[CONTRIBUTE](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Ffoundation%2Fyearend%2F/1/0100019f2562e19e-144adade-b5f0-448b-b4a0-822bad529aad-000000/6jiG4RKh_TQGcV1oNrHgm_xk5sXt3yXCMuBQLqMFw3w=452) _This email list is a joint venture of the following separate organizations: Tea Party Patriots Action, Inc., Tea Party Patriots Foundation, and Tea Party Patriots Citizens Fund. All rights reserved.__Tea Party Patriots Action, Inc. operates as a social welfare organization under section 501(c)(4) of the Internal Revenue Code. Contributions to Tea Party Patriots Action, Inc. are not deductible as charitable contributions for income tax purposes._ To donate by mail, send your check made payable to:[_**Tea Party Patriots Foundation**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Ffoundation%2Fdonate%2F/1/0100019f2562e19e-144adade-b5f0-448b-b4a0-822bad529aad-000000/OSUeTDQIQkTUtpKpTioSsAnjjrpFjONNwoWoF6RQLpY=452)
2295 Towne Lake Pkwy Ste 116-314
Woodstock, GA 30189Want to change how you receive these emails?
You can [unsubscribe](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Ftpot.teapartypatriots.org%2Fcontact-preferences%2F01jp3rk1m05jb3jy5xyw9vqr5t%3Fct=1ebd6a5833cd%26et=a8fe34ad85d9/1/0100019f2562e19e-144adade-b5f0-448b-b4a0-822bad529aad-000000/nB6cbTWOpNj_AId4lWOg1JB7MrwjBU9ygP5VU7b4lLI=452) or [update your preferences](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Ftpot.teapartypatriots.org%2Fcontact-preferences%2F01jp3rk1m05jb3jy5xyw9vqr5t%3Fct=1ebd6a5833cd%26et=a8fe34ad85d9/2/0100019f2562e19e-144adade-b5f0-448b-b4a0-822bad529aad-000000/BomIycOlObb9vdnA-8wKzxPyuxnXAV2w6HpGHbOSyEE=452).

---
| | Dear Peter,
**BREAKING NEWS!** Kshama’s independent socialist campaign for Congress **has won the endorsement of** _**The Stranger**_**newspaper!**
_The Stranger_ has been described by _The New York Times_ as "a progressive kingmaker." It has an online readership of a half million monthly and is the objectively **most important endorsement in the Seattle area.**
Kshama’s main opponent is 29-year incumbent Adam Smith, who has been funding the genocide in Gaza and who is bankrolled by AIPAC and the war profiteers. We agree with _The Stranger_ that, _**“Kshama Sawant has the best chance of unseating incumbent Rep. Adam Smith, the unapologetic AIPAC darling whose weapons industry funding and long pro-war career have made him a pariah in his own district.”**_
Kshama and our antiwar socialist campaign are fighting for an end to:
* All military aid to Israel
* All weapons and tech, including AI, for genocide and imperialist war
* All financing mechanisms for the Israeli military and violent occupation
* All imports of weapons and goods that could serve military purposes

Kshama’s campaign is calling for a permanent arms embargo on Israel.
Kshama is also fighting for free healthcare for all funded by taxing the rich, to shut down ICE and the detention centers, to stop the AI data centers and mass layoffs, and for a public-sector living-wage jobs guarantee.
Kshama has a proven record of building powerful movements of working people to go to war against the political establishment and win historic victories. She has shown time and time again that she will not back down even under intense pressure. That’s the kind of fighter working people need in Congress!
As _The Stranger_ noted, _**“Even Sawant’s liberal detractors can agree she’d make life Hell for Congressional Republicans and the Trump administration if we send her to DC. Smith and his disastrous pro-war stances need to be removed from office before he can do any more damage to both his district and the world. Vote Sawant.”**_
Kshama’s unrelenting approach to fighting for the working class has meant that establishment politicians fear getting exposed. Adam Smith did not even dare attend the candidate interview. As _The Stranger_ said, _**"We’d quote him directly, but he didn’t have the guts to step into the octagon with Sawant."**_
Read the [full endorsement article](https://us.list-manage.com/zWe1FAdSd7b?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) online.
_The Stranger_ also had a few things to say about the two-faced politics of the other Democrat in this race, Melissa Chaudhry. As _The Stranger_ revealed, **Chaudhry has attempted to** _**“deceive voters”**_ on which party she has allegiance to. Shockingly, Chaudhry also _**“admitted her website lacked policy on protecting LGBTQ rights because it would alienate”**_ a particular community. What about the people in that community who are LGBTQ themselves? And which groups of voters is Chaudhry lying to about her positions on LGBTQ rights or on the Democratic Party?
_The Stranger_ points out that _**“[Chaudhry’s] campaign this year is in worse shape, raising only $1,500 per FEC filings at the time of the SECB endorsement meeting"**_ — an extremely weak position to challenge a 29-year incumbent Democrat. Our revolutionary socialist campaign has raised over $630,000 from more than 5,600 donors. We have more than seven times as many donors as Adam Smith.
_The Stranger_ noted how important it is that progressive voters looking to defeat Adam Smith vote for Kshama. As they say, _**“Chaudhry risks splitting the progressive vote in the primary and handing Smith an easy reelection.”**_
There are **only FIVE WEEKS left to go** before the August 4th primary election!! Help us deliver a huge blow to AIPAC and the pro-genocide Zionist lobby. Let’s make sure EVERY voter who wants to throw Adam Smith out of office votes for Kshama!
**Please donate and volunteer, so we can make life hell for Trump and all the political servants of the billionaires in Congress — in both parties — beginning this November.**
Let’s fight to elect the first-ever revolutionary socialist to the U.S. Congress.

The Supreme Court struck down President Trump's order to end birthright citizenship, 6-3, in an opinion written by conservative Chief Justice John Roberts. [The first American pope is planning a "somber" Fourth of July.](https://us.list-manage.com/11RRoyjXdoS?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) And a Democratic Socialist who blames America for 9/11 just won her primary in deep-blue Denver.

[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/I3bSL6BDrBB?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
**🏛️ THE SUPREME COURT DEFIED TRUMP, THEN HANDED HIM A WIN**

So much for "it's just Trump's court." The order to end birthright citizenship is dead, 6-3, and the man who wrote the opinion was conservative Chief Justice John Roberts, with Amy Coney Barrett signing on.

Here's the part that got lost in the shuffle: that same morning, the Court handed Trump a straight-up win somewhere else.Three rulings came down. We walk through all of them, including the one nobody's talking about.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/nyIHHzp5BY0?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
**⛪ THE POPE IS PLANNING A "SOMBER" FOURTH OF JULY
**
The first American pope scheduled his July 4th trip in a way the Vatican openly calls a "message to Washington." On the country's 250th birthday. Mark had some thoughts about what the vicar of Christ should probably be doing instead.

**🚩 A SOCIALIST WHO BLAMES AMERICA FOR 9/11 IS HEADED TO CONGRESS
**
Her name is Melat Kiros. On camera, she called 9/11 "the inevitable consequence" of American foreign policy. Read that one twice. Even James Carville says she's "a bridge too far," and Carville doesn't rattle easily. Wait until you hear what she wants to do next.

**🦁 THE VISITOR THAT KEEPS COMING BACK**

A couple of bucks turned up for boys' night out on the game cam. Then, late that night, the mountain lion strolled through again like he owns the place. Mark swears it's the same cat making his rounds every five weeks. Krysty would rather not know.

### Do you have what it takes to be on Team Kat?
#### Hi there!
#### I’m reaching out because we’re getting closer to this primary election every day. We have a serious chance to win and change Wisconsin for the better...but I need your help to do it!
|
---|---|---
I’ve been travelling around District 8 for months, visiting our communities, talking to citizens, families, veterans, workers, and every day Wisconsinites. One thing I’ve heard has been really clear; people are genuinely ready for a change. Real changes like we’ve talked about for over 50 years. Fixing our healthcare system, increasing pay for Wisconsin workers, bringing down the prices of groceries, gas, and everything we use on a daily basis. People here are struggling to get by, but it doesn’t have to be this way. We need programs like Medicare For All, a $22 Minimum Wage, Universal Childcare, Taxing the Oligarchs and lowering taxes for middle class citizens. We need to End Citizens United, Protect Human Rights, Abolish ICE and stomp out hate! And we need to hold those accountable who have been unamerican and unconstitutional, beginning with Impeaching Donald Trump on Day 1.
---
I know we have the power to get there and the fierce energy to make these things happen, but I need your help! I’m looking for volunteers who would like to join Team Kat! We always are always looking for anyone willing to pitch in, no matter how much or how little you’re able to lend a hand with. Your voice, your energy, and your determination can make all the difference! Do you have a special skill or talent that would be really helpful to the campaign? Would you like to take an active role in fixing this government and putting strong social safety net programs in place so we can all live much better lives? If the answer is YES to any of those questions, click the button below to come join the Team! From door knockers to post card mailers, canvassers, artists, web designers, organizers, activists, street teams and everyone in between - I need your help to get to Washington! Please give the Join Team Kat button a click and come on over! We’ll be genuinely glad to see you! We can do this together...YES WE CAN!
---

---|---
**Good Morning!** On this day in 1775, [George Washington formally took command](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DtuwzAQBNDTSB0FeinrU7BIo85pUwqUuLTW4Ucg1xZ0-8BBbpD6YQaD-brNN0Oe4v3TBNTs0hzxKB6ZMc97TnsqaANaWk3G_PSYcUE_g4ROyF5INVtD_pzb2mqHCKhq1Jd-ULJvr52qN73Iq11Ui8uwOONat0g5XHCRbjQA7XWtSb_bZC_VRcII0Ayjs9DJdTUdgBuxaiVa4pSbR6LIGzp_phfmZk2h9npj3kulPiqYKpiO42g2Kpzy-fYKJt6oCGtOQVH8SQXT4-lPod4BUzaKd05RsPnGItYUgolWJCfWFJkiRjZemBzOOmu7H-Q9la6vWnkPhvzvDP7Xdy8NPwEAAP__8oOGgQ) of the Continental Army at Cambridge Common in Massachusetts. He accepted the role without pay, asking only to be reimbursed for his expenses. Did you know America also declared independence from the [King's English](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHSoyAUxfGn0U6HXAhqQbGNXbbd0kE4xLuL4iDGydvvJK_wdac6v5n_n8f0sBx5e_62K0wJadpwHRGlIE97Tns64Fd4djYjnxEZM-JEgnQjukbIyVuO70nV3gSAIGuYW9dL0am7lvVilLXOae_o1vXBe6WE7u93KKnlPCj4ms3nTXRC3gQNRG0_BE9aOGc1URhQKQHPJeX2b-KtLAjxnV7IrUtrHc1Syn5U8ldFY0XjdV3tPLvWpfb8V9EYznJmVDTaXNjFz_pyWopmSVdjV2R2tsng7YWtwDfYnpGPpc7G7xfHyIfuKiWeq-X4NcuPQr0M_Q8AAP__mW588g)? Today's edition looks at how we ended up spelling things our own way, from "honor" to "center," thanks largely to one stubborn dictionary maker named Noah Webster. We have details below. Today's sponsor, [Splash Spotless Cleaning Products](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGL4zAQhX-N3MXII2dkFyoCwXBF7pqDLYVsjWItsmUkJSb_flmn32a7b5iPx-N93PTN-ODX-1-zkCou6pX2HKgUSnpLcYuZ7ELWTyZRegRKNFLQwAFPXJ640Nb48NJtZZUjAhIVqUZ2gsv2jKKaFYfW0ihaaSeJbdOcsTP92Hd0HhsuLFVefadxyUXDoQeou95ZQD5NBgFcT6zlZH2Jqf6Mfi0zufCKT0r1FJcqqLmULTNxYTAwGPZ9r-9U8hZMnqdAZn2LDIZncyLHxKDJ6ZLMms1UfFy1t0xcGWA8QCIDNM4dBwjBAB8HY4c_SfkxNkxc_w__GOBl-HN9f6qk7Lb7EHxGyVp-X4wPR_Pyq7mfCr4CAAD__y_-jew), is here to upgrade your spring cleaning routine with a hands-free foam toilet cleaner that tackles stains and odors without scrubbing--just pour, let it foam, and flush for a fresh, sparkling bathroom.

## New Rule Targets $1.1 Billion in Drug Markups
The Trump administration proposed a rule Thursday to stop hospitals from [marking up discounted drugs](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOnDAQBOCnMZ1PZs0ZKFykQWn-NClSogWvfzYyGNl7d7q3j4iSJ_jrkUbzza-P-QM58fH5A3fyEvN80KsmEqEynyWfuVLYKfCKhcojUaGF0gwGnDa9NnYOyOk9d03wkQjINuTbfrCm7-7ONpt3zuKA8W7jguPY2iUMq1s6itQDRhMa9leb6Y1tDYwAt2GMAZxZV3QAcSTVGQosudx-Zz5ko5je-Unltua9SX4TOauy3xRMCiZc1ktwZQqm74RJNgXTiwv9lFzeCiYpj_3UGHY-uEpB4Xzof9aqL6Su-CT9n61PFKZDqm5b3dquM_cR2qb4cL44Ja6uV5353JHT30nypR-fHv4EAAD__-0TiW4) for Medicare patients, projecting $1.1 billion in savings for consumers next year. The current 340B program lets hospitals serving low-income patients buy drugs at steep discounts, then bill insurers far more. One prostate cancer drug costs hospitals about $700 per dose but brings in roughly $5,000. ## Contractor Convicted in $1.1M MRE Theft
A federal jury in El Paso convicted a former soldier turned Fort Bliss contractor of [stealing more than $1.1 million](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAUhJ8Gd6z4xxQUadzdtCmts3B8jQTLFT5ar98-cl4h1RQjfZr5_nytX1BqeX3_hoaRPltfX3geFYlwrFK2NpB23IjwqJBHeeNIO6xKKMeF50KvGUq9VjPl-BQ5yAmj9LMW3jklpz2qgN4YrVB4Z5OeweeE6O0sTVCIdirxhgkvtJRCG_nwWc4GISWtZTAuMCMwF-rjQTsSfuDY6tXfOB6pt6nGnejnYPoXUwtTy3mej3MDuEumFhhUUkWmlvvXHUClv_jZR81MLVsfDQeH0S5-9JoLDp76610SYeYHIdx2eCu1EIyLN4R6Y6zw3M72KYIT3G8OuPHC8qcLgaMFZTeD6JOcRsw_Z6m1HM4zI74blPpvOP2f7ndUfwMAAP__bnuSUg) worth of military meals. Joseph Lavar Davis, 47, used his access to the base's requisition system to move [more than 200 pallets](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O5SAMRp-GdFzxE8HcgmKbdLPtlpEHzAStCSOwkrlvv2JfYRrLkmUff-fP-_4Ohcr5-RsqBv7ObT_xHoTM2Heta-3IB2ZmHASplwt7PGA3yjipvFR2T1Dota9LCh8qPfWCQfs3q7xzRi9HwGwwwdMo5bKL6KPLFgCTU9ZaG2EpYR5TXlmtlV31wyf9tiLEaK1-ru4pVoWpcOsPPpDxG0amV7uwP2KrC4WD-WsI-0uYTZjtvu_H3wE8h8JsM40wG7UIJMw2UcJsys-ihdly6xW7HI1SwS5jO68SGZNsWQ5GmG5kakTQtTayFqLSTlnO2RaG_pIVgYbMvVWZW2f5QWVM5tJD-rrnwnBerOqzQqH_P_PPTF_B_AsAAP__nj2TIA) of Meals, Ready-to-Eat (MREs) off post over six months in 2020, according to the U.S. Attorney's Office. Prosecutors said he generated fraudulent paperwork and rented commercial trucks to haul the loads. An active-duty soldier helped load the cargo, and an intermediary funneled the rations to a local business owner who sold them online. The scheme [unraveled in August 2020](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LvupCAYBfCnwQ7DxctQUGxjN9tuaRA-lA2IgU-defuN-wr_-iTnnPz-vOe3CTHs62-TQOPH53mHu0ZAhDJznlIB3MAjQo3GlXBBsZuZBRMDZSNlcnYmxO_cNU4vzCnegObjS7JxGARvNi1Hr3o-LFZ5Bb18ia730ivFmFv6xfEm6KeMjUxyzmTH29HxVwfGWim56gZFOgYuYC4tboDwMdXHb76gtDanJuoN8ahE_iJiImK677v9e1YMFto1X0RMZzWZ3g4_RExHIWLyuSQotOboAhSKZ9nBUZt3LMZiLtTnc3d0PUPEL60I5hGizyTlNIUYQ95pKlApRHqYmpui3XE_QR1G0rE1mRD_38OfoV5a_AsAAP__VCKOjQ), when FBI and Army investigators found roughly 100 pallets of the stolen rations in an El Paso warehouse. Davis was convicted of conspiracy and theft of government property. He was indicted alongside three co-conspirators in February 2025.
## Gas Line Unmarked before Dallas Blast
The natural gas line that exploded and destroyed a Dallas apartment building in May had [not been identified and marked](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u3SAUhFeDOyz-AnZBkcbdS5vSAnO4Rjo2Fpxc37f7yNlCytFIo_m-31_rVyhYztevcICnT67rCXdHIIK2SnkcDWiHTAQdQ2rlDW3bw6qEslw4LvSaQsHv1QzJR5FmOYCXbtLCWavksPtpm6cUVZRS2piznFIWP2x0yYYpOz0PxT9jwgktpdBGji7JyUDYNq3lbOzMjIBUqLaRdiD4hJ7xu76hjVs9BvQ70dWZ_snUwtRy3_d4xi3l-6mZWh4ephasW8AnUo-8wVUb8RQQQ-e5NODhCo0OOInHPwVTOV8cPhfWXurJ1GKE0U5NTC1D8-m6C2Lp1jEjXkco-O8K_Z_At1d_AwAA__-46oUU) before a drill rig punctured it, federal investigators say. The May 28 blast in Oak Cliff killed three people and injured at least five others. The National Transportation Safety Board's preliminary report says the engineering firm filed a Texas 811 locate request [a week before drilling](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OgzAQhJ_GdEa7NoehcHENXa69Ei14EyyZH9mrkLz9ibzCtTOa0TfzextvFFPcHj-0spfXfR83PktiEc4j4rpmloXvIlwShRyfnOeFRgOm1eA02DFQTO-xqYKfIPRYsUfXWXBta7BaPAO0BtBO2FlGmpE5uK_GdAQ9IcxV9FcZOLCIYBusXcCuYZpna7Fv2l41wCHKnmtZWPhF5Z7e-5NzPe9rlfwichRlv5UZlBnO86znqVwrLl-Z4RNRZrgkZYYHFc2vI-0l7psOlBIVTQdlWXkTvUmZdOZjz6KdRn3BKTNU2YfjjCnF0jrVwGOlmD4A8r_bnt78BQAA___x2IDq), and locators marked some underground lines, but not the gas line. A drill rig operated by Barba Drilling, taking soil samples for an engineering firm, [punctured the line](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u2zAQhE8jdTT49yi5YJHG3UubUliLS4vIkhTIjSXfPlCukG6KwWC-79f38g2JUnn9hIyez1iXgkcnZMa2KJVzQ94wMmMnCC29sa0bLFpqJ-QkpFkCJPosdgz-KcNdjejVNBs5OafVuPkva3SUCNHNLhoEO5tgcIUZHEKwX2Py15icpFFKGqtuU1CzRVhXY9TduvtgJYbEtd14Q8YTeqRPfWO7rTWP5DfmvQ_mx6Afg34cx3GL9bQXxlUY9OOKg378KRnabwziBV1QKiieBBmDiMBAIgARdAE7NM5YWOC5U-2pFlG4P8XekFJOBdpHNNxrY9HwjUB9bD7sRyJK3U2Dla8Mif6d4_9T-vb6bwAAAP__LVGPFg) shortly before the explosion. Pipeline experts say investigators must still determine whether the crew followed proper excavation practices. The board stressed its findings are preliminary and the investigation into the cause is ongoing. Atmos Energy and its line-locating contractor are among the parties to the federal probe, and the utility faces lawsuits over the blast.

Abilene 🌤️ 100°/77° | Amarillo 🌤️ 98°/71° | Austin 🌤️ 97°/75° | Brownsville 🌤️ 97°/79° | Corpus Christi 🌤️ 92°/78° | DFW 🌤️ 98°/79° | El Paso 🌤️ 102°/78° | Houston 🌤️ 94°/77° | Laredo 🌤️ 101°/77° | Lubbock 🌤️ 96°/72° | Midland 🌤️ 99°/75° | San Antonio 🌤️ 96°/75° | Tyler ⛈️ 94°/76° | Waco ☀️ 98°/76° | Contractor Convicted in $1.1M MRE Theft A federal jury in El Paso convicted a former soldier turned Fort Bliss contractor of worth of military meals. Joseph Lavar Davis, 47, used his access to the base's requisition system to move of Meals, Ready-to-Eat (MREs) off post over six months in 2020, according to the U.S. Attorney's Office. Prosecutors said he generated fraudulent paperwork and rented commercial trucks to haul the loads. An active-duty soldier helped load the cargo, and an intermediary funneled the rations to a local business owner who sold them online. The scheme , when FBI and Army investigators found roughly 100 pallets of the stolen rations in an El Paso warehouse. Davis was convicted of conspiracy and theft of government property. He was indicted alongside three co-conspirators in February 2025. Gas Line Unmarked before Dallas Blast The natural gas line that exploded and destroyed a Dallas apartment building in May had before a drill rig punctured it, federal investigators say. The May 28 blast in Oak Cliff killed three people and injured at least five others. The National Transportation Safety Board's preliminary report says the engineering firm filed a Texas 811 locate request , and locators marked some underground lines, but not the gas line. A drill rig operated by Barba Drilling, taking soil samples for an engineering firm, shortly before the explosion. Pipeline experts say investigators must still determine whether the crew followed proper excavation practices. The board stressed its findings are preliminary and the investigation into the cause is ongoing. Please forgive the lengthy letter

| | | | [](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUks1u3CwYha8G7xjxY2Bm4UX0-Zuqi1RRKjVL9BqoTWWDxY9HydVXpJPsuugOvZxzHjjw8qgfwa8-zN9gc4M5vE5Z32KyuSxQbn5dswsW8uIPl6xmhElMFCa86WhnB2MlZ50bqDpzoi60v3TLYNQ0TZQrMU09I0rIs1B9L3-CkcKA5J0fWhJRhFPai56dzkCVBQpCGWHN5YJ6UncLxeWTiSG7dEDxh_MhxLaK4WTi1q3DUsqeEX9A7IrYNTtTkzvdfEjONgVi1-IsNqm-IXbdZ50ydpoSKvEedzAFcLrhX3V9xX1Z8MSEvh-MatCxIH6tZdM51mQc4uOzO74vkBxiss2LQXz878dX_HGb-9zAtoOfQ9tN9e0P8CnuDw34_PIJ_ITdfZuzvm6Ij_9v4NePsBiKCwXx8W8xdyHMLphXxMenL4hJ2GJ9dwmBmEytmeTDjPhYUnVdGuzentdnqVBP5gZ877T8-y84BvY7AAD__4h5vqs)

| | | Dear Patriot, Please forgive the lengthy letter, but we're celebrating an emotional moment in our nation's history, _and every word I 've written comes straight from the heart_. 250 years ago, the greatest, freest, and most prosperous nation in history was born. Our Founding Fathers boldly took on the world's largest empire to declare our independence and proclaim that our rights and freedoms do not come from government - but from _Almighty God Himself_. When Benjamin Franklin was asked what sort of government America has, he said... **_" A Republic, if you can keep it..."_** Those words send a shiver down my spine every time I read them. You and I both know firsthand how hard we must work to keep it. We've all witnessed how close our Republic has come to the brink. How many times have we seen our freedoms get trampled on? ...Our freedom of speech, our Second Amendment rights, our religious liberties, our right to privacy, our right to make medical choices, our right to leave our home during the COVID lockdowns, our right to run a business, our right to private property - and so many more - have all been challenged time and time again by those who wish to see our Republic fail. But every single time there's been even the smallest encroachment on our freedom, patriots like YOU have recalled the courage and resilience of our Founding Fathers and stood up in the name of liberty. **And by God, America has survived 250 years as a Free Republic.** As we celebrate this incredible milestone in not just American history but _world history_ , we cannot forget that the enemies of freedom are still hard at work. So my question to you is this: **_will you do your part to keep it?_** **So if you can, and only if you can - I really mean it - [please make a contribution of _$17.76_ to ensure that America survives another 250 years. Turning Point USA is still right there with them...

On campus. In 5,000+ student chapters. Training young leaders. And carrying Charlie's mission forward.

Peter, _Right Wing Revolution_ is the battle plan Charlie left for this moment.

It's not an ordinary political book...

It's a roadmap for winning back our culture and the hearts and minds of young Americans.

**Inside, Charlie lays out a vision for an America where: ** ✅ Faith and patriotism are celebrated, not silenced
✅ Our borders are secure and our Constitution is respected
✅ We trust our neighbors and feel safe in our communities
✅ The next generation grows up God-fearing and loving this country

That's the America Charlie fought for. That's the mission Turning Point USA carries forward.

**And Peter, that 's the work your gift of $50 or more today helps make possible.**

Now we either keep doing it...

Or we hand those students right back to the Left.

That means showing up on the campuses they thought they owned.

Standing in front of the students they thought they had captured.

That's how Charlie sparked a revolution. That's how he changed a country.

And that's how we keep winning -- _one student, one campus, one courageous conversation at a time. _
